correctness.rationale: The construction is exact: two identical coordinate-line families on \(\mathbb{R}^2\) are Parseval for every weaving, while intersecting with \(\operatorname{span}\{e_1+e_2\}\) makes every component zero. The source proof uses \(P_{M\cap W}=P_M P_W\); self-adjointness shows this identity forces commutation, and commuting orthogonal projections conversely multiply to the intersection projection. The matrix calculation verifies the failed identity directly. No finite experiment is extrapolated to an infinite claim.
